nav_map_delegation_toolbox_blockchain_sy.description: Full synergy between the Nav Map, delegated work system, per-room Toolboxes, Jeeves team selection, and the Blockchain Log System.
key_synergies: Nav Map is the central interface for posting and tracking delegated work
Toolboxes in each room use Nav Map data to gather the right team quickly
Jeeves uses Nav Map + logs (blockchain) to make optimal team selections
All delegation, repair, and team activities are immutably logged on the blockchain for fast problem isolation
Agentic Queue prevents overload during delegation surges
Zero Trust and Byzantine Fault Tolerance protect the entire delegation and repair flow
nav_map_delegation_toolbox_blockchain_sy.overall_effect: The system becomes highly coordinated, secure, auditable, and efficient at Mishima Zaibatsu operational standards.
